name: A one-cubic-metre null result could constrain specified undirected technomaterial scenarios
summary: Under the v4 model, a null detection in about one cubic metre of characterized lunar regolith would exclude scenarios in which Solar-type stars typically disperse more than approximately 0.10 Earth-mass equivalents of long-lived artificial particulate debris over Galactic history.

claimMetadata.caution: This claim records the authors' model, proposal or evidentiary clarification; it is not an independent GreyAlien detection claim.
